metadata.geometry: Centered circles (midpoint-strip approximation), axis-aligned rectangles and uniform films; common x/y periods
metadata.polarization_convention: Incident s=(-sin(phi),cos(phi),0); each outgoing order uses local s/p; zero transverse vector uses incident azimuth
metadata.power_normalization: Unit incident normal Poynting flux; semi-infinite substrate entrance-plane T
metadata.material_interpolation: Linear n and k separately; extrapolation forbidden
metadata.regularization: none; no damping, pseudoinverse, angular perturbation, or clipping

warnings: Convergence not assessed for this input. A single run and flux balance do not certify accuracy.
